image_urls.description: Minimalist abstract 3D render of a clean white control room or laboratory data environment, cinematic lighting. To be used as the split-screen background for Login/Register pages.
Macro photography of an intricate metallic engine component. Can be used in empty states or banner areas within the app.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color mappings for the 6 lifecycle states in all badges, charts, and list items.
Do NOT use generic card shadows everywhere. Use explicit 1px borders (#E2E8F0) and flat backgrounds for a structural engineering look.
Use Lucide-React for icons, ensuring consistent stroke-width (1.5 or 2).
In the Dataset Detail page, use the 'tabs' component styling mapped in this file (underline style, not pills).
In the Traceability Explorer, use a clean layout (e.g., react-flow or simple CSS flex/grid branches) to show Software -> Dataset -> Vehicle linkage.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, tabs, and form elements.
Ensure 'Inter' is NOT used for headings. Stick to 'Chivo' for headers and 'IBM Plex Sans' or 'Inter' for body.
Implement the UI using raw Tailwind HTML/JSX structure for layout, and customized Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Dropdowns, Tabs).
Avoid generic 'SaaS purple' gradients. Rely on high contrast grayscale with specific functional colors.
